input.command:
cat > /tmp/run_s0_mideval.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate occsafe
cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/vanilla_s0/openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug"

for STEP in 35000 40000 45000; do
    CKPT="${CKPT_BASE}--${STEP}_chkpt"
    OUT="/root/occsafe_vla/eval_results/vanilla_s0_step${STEP}.json"
    
    if [ -f "$OUT" ] && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$OUT')); assert 'overall' in d" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "SKIP step ${STEP}: result already exists"
        continue
    fi
    
    echo "START step ${STEP} at $(date)"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0 python vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py \
        --model_family openvla \
        --pretrained_checkpoint "$CKPT" \
        --task_suite_name libero_spatial \
        --num_steps_wait 10 \
        --num_rollouts 20 \
        --center_crop True \
        --use_l1_regression True \
        --num_images_in_input 2 \
        --use_proprio True \
        --output_path "$OUT"
    echo "DONE step ${STEP} at $(date)"
done
echo "ALL_DONE" > /tmp/s0_mideval_status.txt
SCRIPT
echo "Script written"
